newsitem.title: USA: New World says raises $2.5 mln in offering.
newsitem.headline: New World says raises $2.5 mln in offering.

text.p: New World Coffee Inc said Monday it raised more than $2.5 million in a secondary equity offering.
The company said the offering, structured as a minimum of $250,000 and maximum of $2.5 million, was oversubscribed.
The company also said it expects "strong second quarter comparisons."
The company, which was the placement agent for the offering, said the financing was for working capital purposes.
It also said it added three new institutional investors through this offering. A company goal in 1997 has been to increase institutional sponsorship of its stock.
The company said it will not need to access the public equity markets for the "foreseeable future."
